changelog:
Initial release of omni-agent-builder — a tool for generating secure, high-performing OpenClaw agent workspaces.

- Generates all required OpenClaw workspace files with robust, secure defaults.
- Supports both single-agent and advanced multi-agent (Planner/Executor/Critic) team setups.
- Incorporates best practices for team orchestration and Personal Intelligence (Pi) memory management.
- Provides built-in workflows for user interview, customization, evaluation, and acceptance testing.
- CLI-focused design for fast local setup, iteration, and deployment.
